description: Produces developer integration recipes for the Learnosity Author API. The client describes an integration design — which authoring experience to embed (item editor, item browser, activity editor, activity list) and how it's configured (allowed widget types, editor permissions, item bank, locked mode). L0177 validates the design, flags holes (missing required properties like the serving domain, the author user id, or the item reference) as steering warnings, and via get_spec returns a host-language-neutral recipe: goal, preconditions, procedure, gotchas, and runnable verification steps. It does NOT author item content (that is L0176) and does NOT emit runnable code.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I embed the Learnosity item editor in my LMS for author u123 on lms.acme.edu, allowing only MCQ and cloze questions?
example_prompts.notes: Names the experience (item editor), the serving domain, the author identity, and restricts widget types — a well-specified design with few holes.

example_prompts.prompt: I want to embed a Learnosity item browser so my authors can find and open existing items.
example_prompts.notes: The item_list view; the recipe covers signing + wiring, and warns that domain and user id are still needed.

example_prompts.prompt: How do I embed the Learnosity activity editor so instructional designers can assemble activities from our item bank?
example_prompts.notes: The activity_edit view; reference is optional (new vs existing activity).

example_prompts.prompt: Embed the Learnosity item editor in read-only mode for a review workflow.
example_prompts.notes: Uses locked (read-only) edit mode; the verification steps check the editor renders read-only.
